# Chalkboard

> Chalkboard is a learning company in Bengaluru, India. It runs small-batch school tuitions, interactive corporate training and placement programmes for colleges. It grew out of Home Tuitions Bangalore, which has taught since 2018.

## Chalkboard Tuitions
- [Tuitions](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/tuitions): Daily small-batch tuitions for Grades 1–10 at 2nd Floor, Pooja Arcade, 50/2, Kammanahalli Main Rd, St Thomas Town, Bengaluru 560084 — near Kalyan Nagar, HRBR Layout and Banaswadi. Phone/WhatsApp +91 74114 46381. Maximum 8 students per batch. CBSE, ICSE and Karnataka State Board. Weekday batches, 4 PM to 8 PM. Free demo class.
- [Contact](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/contact): Book a free demo class.

## Chalkboard Learning Studio
- [Corporate training](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio): Interactive training for teams in Bengaluru and online: AI at work, sales, customer support, team effectiveness and leadership. Also builds custom courses from a company's own material.
- [Colleges and universities](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/colleges): Placement readiness, industry technology tracks and faculty development.
- [Trainers](https://www.chalkboardlearning.in/learning-studio/trainers): Freelance trainers, subject experts and facilitators can send their profile.
